_note: Frontend fixture for GET /events/{id}/procedure (#47 §3, FE-03). Draft shape until the backend sample lands. Steps and cite ids copied from backend/model/procedure_steps.json (#49): AI-written summaries of an older (2001) ISS checklist, not reviewed by a person. client.js fills event_id, patient (the reporter) and consenters (two other crew members, C1 and C3 first, as in the demo where C4 reports chest pain).

text.ko: 통증을 묻고 적으세요: 위치, 퍼지는지, 세기(1~10), 계속되는지, 얼마나 됐는지, 어떤 느낌인지.
text.en: Ask about the pain and write it down: location, spreading or not, strength (1-10), constant or not, how long, what it feels like.

text.ko: 활력 징후를 5분마다 재서 30분 동안 적으세요: 혈압, 맥박, 호흡수, 체온, 산소 포화도.
text.en: Measure vital signs every 5 minutes for 30 minutes: blood pressure, pulse, breathing rate, temperature, oxygen saturation.

text.ko: 심전도를 지켜보고, 청진기로 심장 소리와 숨소리를 확인하세요.
text.en: Monitor the ECG and check heart and breath sounds with a stethoscope.

text.ko: 지상의 담당 의사에게 연락하세요. 연락이 닿지 않을 때의 처치는 약이 들어 있어 이 화면에서 안내하지 않습니다.
text.en: Contact the flight surgeon. Treatment for when the surgeon cannot be reached involves medicines and is not shown on this screen.
